title: Retain hosted execution graph acceptance within its measured build
question: Does the recorded graph instrumentation meet the overhead and artifact acceptance gates in its tested hosted scope?
summary: All 126 retained eligible jobs verify and all eight overhead cells pass on the pre-merge build; the execution graph remains local and performance of the main-integrated engine is unmeasured.

workloads: Direct, resident/fused, external merge and high-cardinality synthetic complete Runs, graph disabled/collapsed/expanded, fresh persistent Chromium Headless Shell OPFS profiles on Linux/WSL.

validation.summary: The unchanged compact receipt references pre-merge native/UI, portable WASM compile, hosted graph/lifecycle, resource-denial and production-package attempts. Actual Linux checks run in WSL; this does not establish native Windows/macOS coverage. Merged-source correctness is separate and does not transfer old performance acceptance. Merged source db1ae50 separately passes Linux/WSL default/all-feature/UI/portable checks, bundled Chromium graph/lifecycle/termination and both resource variants, with production restored. The first hosted plan omitted a codec-helper launch-time hash; its supplemental snapshot and limitation are retained.

limitations: Acceptance belongs to source 488525ef0c6465f994b39247c8237ff70c8eb3ca and the exact production assets recorded in the report, not the engine after integrating origin/main 80894c6f0ba13ce1fa940e87002a97450b0dff06.
Precision extensions followed unmet gates; uncertainty is conditional paired bootstrap with no population, tail or optional-stopping-adjusted confidence claim.
Local raw originals remain outside the public catalog; summary extraction is not normalized speed-comparison eligibility.
No native Windows/macOS, installed Chrome/Edge, browser RSS cap or physical-I/O performance claim.
exclusions: Interrupted first cohort, calibration, controls and diagnostics remain retained but excluded from eligible cells.
Earlier unmet 72/108-job reports reuse original observations and are not independent executions.
Correctness durations and cleanup/polling completion clocks are not primary overhead samples.
reopen_when: A changed build requires separately authorized matched measurements before claiming its performance acceptance; this record does not authorize a rerun.
